In the repo /home/nick/work/andesim (branch llamacpp), audit what exists TODAY for packaging and releasing this software as a product ("AndeSim"). Be thorough (medium-high breadth). Report concrete facts with file paths, not opinions.

Specifically find and report:
1. Any LICENSE / COPYING / copyright headers / SPDX tags. Are source files licensed? What license, if any?
2. Any version number anywhere: a VERSION file, a version string in the `andesim` driver source (look in src/ for the C++ driver and any `--version` flag), CMakeLists project(VERSION), git tags (`git tag -l`).
3. Any CHANGELOG / release notes / NEWS.
4. Any install/packaging machinery: `make install`, CMake `install()` rules, a tarball/package script, .deb/.rpm/conda/pip spec, Dockerfile(s) (there is Dockerfile.runtime — what does it do?), any `scripts/*release*` or `*package*`.
5. Any CI config: .github/, .gitlab-ci.yml, Jenkinsfile, .gitea/ workflows.
6. What `setup.sh`, `scripts/build_all.sh`, and `config.env.example` require from the user's machine: list every external path/tool a fresh user must supply (QEMU dir, vsim dir, toolchain, python, cmake versions, etc.), and what happens if missing.
7. The `andesim` file at repo root — is it a script or binary? How does it self-build? What does it depend on?
8. Repo size and any large/binary artifacts committed (git ls-files with sizes; anything > 1MB), plus whether build outputs are gitignored.
9. Submodule setup: .gitmodules content, and whether `include/` submodule is public or internal-only (check its URL).

Return a compact factual inventory organized by the 9 points. Include exact file paths and short quotes where useful.

# andesim driver: a standalone C++20 executable.
#
# Intentionally minimal -- no Verilator, no SystemC, no QEMU, no fmt/spdlog.
# It depends only on the host C++ toolchain and the shared ABI header at
# include/hybrid/state_abi.h (consumed from F5 on for state-file reads).
#
# Build out-of-tree via scripts/build_driver.sh, which points
# CMAKE_RUNTIME_OUTPUT_DIRECTORY at the repo's build/ so the binary lands at
# build/andesim.
cmake_minimum_required(VERSION 3.20)
project(andes_sim CXX)

set(CMAKE_CXX_STANDARD 20)
set(CMAKE_CXX_STANDARD_REQUIRED ON)
set(CMAKE_CXX_EXTENSIONS OFF)

if(NOT CMAKE_BUILD_TYPE)
  set(CMAKE_BUILD_TYPE Release)
endif()

add_executable(andesim
  main.cpp
  cli.cpp
  cmd_list.cpp
  cmd_doctor.cpp
  cmd_run.cpp
  cmd_profile.cpp
  profile.cpp
  hybrid.cpp
  elf_syms.cpp
  log.cpp
  process.cpp
  shm.cpp
  argv.cpp
  run_plan.cpp
  run_passthrough.cpp
  vsim_filter.cpp
  engine_registry.cpp
  state_diff.cpp
  memmap.cpp
  manifest.cpp
  tempdir.cpp
)

# Shared ABI header lives at <repo>/include/hybrid/state_abi.h, two levels up.
target_include_directories(andesim PRIVATE ${CMAKE_CURRENT_SOURCE_DIR}/../include)
target_compile_options(andesim PRIVATE -Wall -Wextra)

# Unit tests. Kept in the build tree (build/driver), not redirected to build/,
# so build/ holds only the shipped binary.
add_executable(andesim-cli-test cli_test.cpp cli.cpp)
add_executable(andesim-json-test json_test.cpp)
add_executable(andesim-infra-test infra_test.cpp process.cpp shm.cpp log.cpp)
add_executable(andesim-plan-test plan_test.cpp argv.cpp run_plan.cpp process.cpp shm.cpp log.cpp tempdir.cpp)
# F6 integration acceptance: spawns real qemu+vsim, so it also needs the registry.
add_executable(andesim-plan-itest plan_itest.cpp argv.cpp run_plan.cpp process.cpp shm.cpp log.cpp engine_registry.cpp tempdir.cpp)
# F7 transparent-passthrough argv assembly (pure; no spawn).
add_executable(andesim-run-test run_test.cpp run_passthrough.cpp argv.cpp process.cpp)
# cycle-mode output filter: banner/[info] suppression + cycle-count lift (pure).
add_executable(andesim-vsimfilter-test vsim_filter_test.cpp vsim_filter.cpp)
# F9 pc-trigger boundary resolver (pure; reads a fixture ELF's .symtab).
add_executable(andesim-elf-syms-test elf_syms_test.cpp elf_syms.cpp)
# F9 hybrid trigger build (pure; resolves pc boundaries against a fixture ELF).
add_executable(andesim-hybrid-test hybrid_test.cpp hybrid.cpp elf_syms.cpp cli.cpp log.cpp)
# verify_oracle F2: the oracle differential compare (pure; synthetic states).
add_executable(andesim-state-diff-test state_diff_test.cpp state_diff.cpp)
# EX1: vsim scan dir picks $VSIM_BIN_DIR (external vsim, mirrors $QEMU_BIN_DIR).
add_executable(andesim-engine-registry-test engine_registry_test.cpp engine_registry.cpp process.cpp)
# hybrid guest memory-map composer (pure; descriptor + qemu.cfg text in, rows out).

# profile core: plugin-log/disasm parsing, RVV filter, loop nesting, renderers,

#!/usr/bin/env bash
# Driver: build the plugin (qemu and vsim are external, prebuilt), then add the
# external build dirs to PATH.
# Source this script to affect your current shell's PATH:
#   source ./setup.sh                       # build all
#   source ./setup.sh clean [target]        # clean vsim|plugin|all (default: all)

if [ -n "${ZSH_VERSION:-}" ]; then
  _SETUP_SRC="${(%):-%x}"
elif [ -n "${BASH_VERSION:-}" ]; then
  _SETUP_SRC="${BASH_SOURCE[0]}"
else
  _SETUP_SRC="$0"
fi

# Wrap the body in a function so strict-mode options stay local and don't
# leak into the caller's interactive shell (which would break zsh prompts
# under nounset).
_hybrid_setup_main() {
  if [ -n "${ZSH_VERSION:-}" ]; then
    emulate -L sh
    setopt err_exit no_unset pipe_fail
  else
    local -
    set -euo pipefail
  fi

  # QEMU_BIN_DIR / VSIM_BIN_DIR are NOT in this local list: they are exported
  # for the caller's shell at the end of this function, and exporting a local
  # dies at function return (the shell pops the scope, children never see it).
  local ROOT PLUGIN_DIR PLUGIN_SO CONFIG_FILE CONFIG_TEMPLATE _arch
  ROOT="$(cd "$(dirname "$_SETUP_SRC")" && pwd)"
  # QEMU_BIN_DIR and VSIM_BIN_DIR (the externally-built qemu-system-* and vsim
  # sim_* build directories) both come from config.env -- this project integrates
  # a prebuilt QEMU and a prebuilt external vsim; it builds neither.
  PLUGIN_DIR="$ROOT/qemu_plugin"
  PLUGIN_SO="$PLUGIN_DIR/libhybrid_handoff.so"
  CONFIG_FILE="$ROOT/config.env"
  CONFIG_TEMPLATE="$ROOT/config.env.example"

  step() { printf '\033[1;34m==>\033[0m \033[1m%s\033[0m\n' "$*"; }
  ok()   { printf '\033[1;32m[ok]\033[0m %s\n' "$*"; }
  err()  { printf '\033[1;31m[err]\033[0m %s\n' "$*" >&2; }

  clean_vsim()   { step "vsim is external (${VSIM_BIN_DIR:-unset})"; ok "not cleaned here -- clean it in your external vsim checkout"; }
  clean_plugin() {
    step "cleaning plugin build ($PLUGIN_DIR)"
    if [ -f "$PLUGIN_DIR/Makefile" ]; then
      make -C "$PLUGIN_DIR" clean
    else
      rm -f "$PLUGIN_SO" "$PLUGIN_DIR"/*.o
    fi
    ok "plugin cleaned"
  }

  if [ "${1:-}" = "clean" ]; then
    case "${2:-all}" in
      vsim)     clean_vsim ;;
      plugin)   clean_plugin ;;
      all)      clean_vsim; clean_plugin ;;
      *)        err "usage: source $_SETUP_SRC clean [vsim|plugin|all]"; return 1 ;;
    esac
    return 0
  fi

  step "0/3 loading per-host config"
  if [ ! -f "$CONFIG_FILE" ]; then
    if [ ! -f "$CONFIG_TEMPLATE" ]; then
      err "missing $CONFIG_TEMPLATE; cannot create $CONFIG_FILE"
      return 1
    fi
    cp "$CONFIG_TEMPLATE" "$CONFIG_FILE"
    ok "created $CONFIG_FILE from template -- edit it if your toolchain lives elsewhere"
  fi
  # shellcheck source=/dev/null
  . "$CONFIG_FILE"
  if [ -z "${HYBRID_TOOLCHAIN:-}" ]; then
    err "HYBRID_TOOLCHAIN not set; check $CONFIG_FILE"
    return 1
  fi
  if [ ! -d "$HYBRID_TOOLCHAIN/bin" ]; then
    err "HYBRID_TOOLCHAIN=$HYBRID_TOOLCHAIN has no bin/ directory; edit $CONFIG_FILE"
    return 1
  fi
  export HYBRID_TOOLCHAIN
  ok "HYBRID_TOOLCHAIN=$HYBRID_TOOLCHAIN"

  step "1/3 locating external qemu (rv32 + rv64)"
  if [ -z "${QEMU_BIN_DIR:-}" ]; then
    err "QEMU_BIN_DIR not set; point it at your qemu-system-* build dir in $CONFIG_FILE"
    return 1
  fi
  for _arch in riscv32 riscv64; do
    if [ ! -x "$QEMU_BIN_DIR/qemu-system-$_arch" ]; then
      err "no qemu-system-$_arch under QEMU_BIN_DIR=$QEMU_BIN_DIR; build both rv32+rv64 QEMU there or edit $CONFIG_FILE"
      return 1
    fi
  done
  ok "qemu <- $QEMU_BIN_DIR/qemu-system-{riscv32,riscv64} (external, prebuilt)"

  step "2/3 locating external vsim"
  if [ -z "${VSIM_BIN_DIR:-}" ]; then
    err "VSIM_BIN_DIR not set; point it at your external vsim build dir (holding sim_* binaries) in $CONFIG_FILE"
    return 1
  fi
  if ! ls "$VSIM_BIN_DIR"/sim_* >/dev/null 2>&1; then
    err "no sim_* under VSIM_BIN_DIR=$VSIM_BIN_DIR; build vsim in your external checkout or edit $CONFIG_FILE"
    return 1
  fi
  ok "vsim <- $VSIM_BIN_DIR (external, prebuilt)"

  step "3/3 building hybrid plugin"
  if [ ! -f "$PLUGIN_DIR/Makefile" ]; then
    err "missing $PLUGIN_DIR/Makefile"
    return 1
  fi
  # Plugins build against the vendored qemu_plugin/include/qemu-plugin.h -- no
  # QEMU source tree required.
  make -C "$PLUGIN_DIR"
  ok "plugin -> $PLUGIN_SO"

  step "PATH: prepending build dirs"
  case ":$PATH:" in
    *":$QEMU_BIN_DIR:"*) ;;
    *) export PATH="$QEMU_BIN_DIR:$PATH" ;;
  esac
  case ":$PATH:" in
    *":$VSIM_BIN_DIR:"*) ;;
    *) export PATH="$VSIM_BIN_DIR:$PATH" ;;
  esac
  ok "PATH updated (this shell only)"

  step "env: exporting QEMU_BIN_DIR / VSIM_BIN_DIR / VSIM_QEMU{,32} / VSIM_PLUGIN for the driver + e2e scripts"
  export QEMU_BIN_DIR
  export VSIM_BIN_DIR
  export VSIM_QEMU="$QEMU_BIN_DIR/qemu-system-riscv64"
  export VSIM_QEMU32="$QEMU_BIN_DIR/qemu-system-riscv32"
  export VSIM_PLUGIN="$PLUGIN_SO"
  ok "QEMU_BIN_DIR=$QEMU_BIN_DIR"
  ok "VSIM_BIN_DIR=$VSIM_BIN_DIR (external vsim; the driver discovers engines here)"
  ok "VSIM_QEMU=$VSIM_QEMU"
  ok "VSIM_QEMU32=$VSIM_QEMU32"
  ok "VSIM_PLUGIN=$VSIM_PLUGIN"

  if [ -n "${BASH_VERSION:-}" ] && [ "${BASH_SOURCE[0]:-}" = "${0:-}" ]; then
    err "script was executed, not sourced - PATH change is local to this subshell"
    err "to update your shell, run: source $_SETUP_SRC"
  fi
}

_hybrid_setup_main "$@"
unset -f _hybrid_setup_main 2>/dev/null
unset _SETUP_SRC

# andesim runtime image -- for run-only hosts (macOS via podman machine).
#
# Built ON LINUX (CI or a Linux workstation); macOS users only pull it:
#
#   podman build -f Dockerfile.runtime \
#     --build-arg BASE_IMAGE=<verilator env image> \
#     -t andesim-runtime:latest .
#
# BASE_IMAGE is the vsim build environment from the external vsim repo's
# root Dockerfile (target `env`) -- the same image its build_vsim.sh builds
# (vsim-env:latest), so the Verilator/SystemC toolchain and QEMU build deps
# are already there.
# The publish registry/name is still an open question; consumers override
# the local default with ANDESIM_IMAGE.
#
# The whole repo is baked, fully built, at /opt/hybrid_sim, so the baked
# ./andesim resolves every artifact via its normal repo-relative paths
# (plugin, runtime). scripts/run_in_container.sh
# invokes that path as the entry; the user's cwd is bind-mounted only for
# ELF inputs and outputs.
ARG BASE_IMAGE=andes-vsim-env:latest
FROM ${BASE_IMAGE}

COPY . /opt/hybrid_sim
WORKDIR /opt/hybrid_sim

# Build: plugin -> driver -> runtime. Both QEMU and vsim are NOT built here --
# they are integrated as external prebuilt binaries; provide them at run time, e.g.
#   -v /path/to/qemu/build:/qemu:ro   -e VSIM_QEMU=/qemu/qemu-system-riscv64
#   -v /path/to/vsim/build:/vsim:ro   -e VSIM_BIN_DIR=/vsim
# (the plugin builds against the vendored qemu_plugin/include/qemu-plugin.h, so
# no QEMU source tree is needed; the driver discovers cycle engines by scanning
# $VSIM_BIN_DIR). setup.sh is NOT used here -- it locates the external qemu/vsim,
# which are mounted at run time, not build time.
RUN make -C qemu_plugin \
 && ./scripts/build_driver.sh \
 && make -C runtime

#!/usr/bin/env bash
# Run andesim inside the prebuilt Linux runtime image -- the macOS path
# (see Dockerfile.runtime; macOS is run-only, builds happen on Linux CI).
#
# Two rules make the hybrid handoff correct across the podman-machine VM:
#   1. The shared mmap stays VM-local: the container's /dev/shm (--shm-size)
#      is tier 1, and the host's HSIM_MMAP_DIR is never forwarded -- a host
#      path would be a virtiofs mount, where MAP_SHARED is not coherent.
#   2. The caller's cwd is bind-mounted at the SAME path, so relative ELF
#      arguments and output files behave as if the run were local (plain
#      file IO is fine across the boundary; only the mmap is not).
set -euo pipefail

ENGINE="${ANDESIM_CONTAINER_ENGINE:-}"
if [ -z "$ENGINE" ]; then
  if command -v podman >/dev/null 2>&1; then ENGINE=podman
  elif command -v docker >/dev/null 2>&1; then ENGINE=docker
  else
    echo "andesim: a macOS run executes inside a Linux VM and needs podman (or docker)" >&2
    echo "           install podman and run: podman machine init && podman machine start" >&2
    exit 2
  fi
fi

IMAGE="${ANDESIM_IMAGE:-andesim-runtime:latest}"
SHM_SIZE="${ANDESIM_SHM_SIZE:-3g}"   # tier 1 ceiling inside the VM
ENTRY="${ANDESIM_IMAGE_ENTRY:-/opt/hybrid_sim/andesim}"

TTY_ARGS=()
if [ -t 0 ] && [ -t 1 ]; then TTY_ARGS=(-it); fi

exec "$ENGINE" run --rm "${TTY_ARGS[@]}" \
  --shm-size "$SHM_SIZE" \
  -v "$PWD:$PWD" \
  -w "$PWD" \
  "$IMAGE" "$ENTRY" "$@"

#!/usr/bin/env bash
# Release-surface contract: the andesim PRODUCT help shows only the finished,
# user-facing commands (run, profile, list, doctor) and never the third-party
# simulator name "verilator". The former developer commands build/test/state-diff
# have moved OUT of the binary (build -> scripts/build_all.sh, test ->
# scripts/test_all.sh, state-diff -> the diff_states core behind `run --verify`):
# they are not listed in any help and are not dispatchable. The removed /
# never-shipped commands (cluster, archive, replay, estimate) must
# not be advertised in any help. The cycle-accurate engine is presented as "vsim" everywhere --
# proven end to end with a fake engine that self-describes as "verilator" and
# must come back out as vsim:.
set -uo pipefail

SCRIPT_DIR=$(cd -- "$(dirname -- "${BASH_SOURCE[0]}")" && pwd)
ROOT=$(cd -- "$SCRIPT_DIR/../.." && pwd)
. "$SCRIPT_DIR/../lib/log.sh"

require_driver

# has RE TEXT  -- TEXT must match RE ; missing RE TEXT -- TEXT must NOT match RE
has()     { printf '%s\n' "$2" | grep -Eq "$1"; }
no_word() { ! printf '%s\n' "$1" | grep -qi 'verilator'; }

# 1. release --help: a clear command TREE -- run/list/doctor are the major
# commands (column 0); each is followed by its indented subcommands (run's
# modes, list's targets); run carries its full option list with REQUIRED flags
# marked. No developer-commands section, no "verilator", no dev-only fixtures.
H=$("$BIN" --help 2>&1)
has '^run '     "$H" || fail "release --help: missing major command 'run':"$'\n'"$H"
has '^profile ' "$H" || fail "release --help: missing major command 'profile':"$'\n'"$H"
has '^list '    "$H" || fail "release --help: missing major command 'list':"$'\n'"$H"
has '^doctor '  "$H" || fail "release --help: missing major command 'doctor':"$'\n'"$H"
for s in fast cycle hybrid; do
  has "^  $s " "$H" || fail "release --help: run missing subcommand '$s':"$'\n'"$H"
done
for t in models engines; do
  has "^  $t " "$H" || fail "release --help: list missing target '$t':"$'\n'"$H"
done
has 'REQUIRED for hybrid' "$H" || fail "release --help: --trigger not marked REQUIRED for hybrid:"$'\n'"$H"
for c in build test state-diff cluster archive replay estimate; do
  has "(^|  )$c " "$H" && fail "release --help: leaked non-release command '$c'"
done
no_word "$H" || fail "release --help: leaked 'verilator'"
has 'developer command' "$H" && fail "release --help: developer commands moved to scripts/; drop the section:"$'\n'"$H"
has '^  fixtures ' "$H" && fail "release --help: leaked dev-only 'fixtures' target:"$'\n'"$H"

# hybrid_sim

Workspace for the Andes hybrid simulator: QEMU 9.x (functional, MHz) + vsim
(SystemC + Verilator, cycle-accurate) sharing memory and architectural state
across a magic-CSR boundary.

Submodule:

- `include/` - the shared ABI (`andesim_abi` repo): the `hybrid_state_v1` wire
  contract under `include/hybrid/`, shared by the plugin, the driver, and vsim.

QEMU and vsim are integrated as prebuilt external binaries (set `QEMU_BIN_DIR` and
`VSIM_BIN_DIR` in `config.env`; see `config.env.example`), not vendored as
submodules. vsim sources live in the separate `hybrid_vsim` repo, built there.

## Quickstart

```sh
git clone --recursive https://gitea.andestech.com/nick/hybrid_sim && cd hybrid_sim
bash scripts/build_all.sh
bash scripts/test_all.sh
```

Subcommands: `run`, `profile`, `list`, `doctor`. Run `./andesim -h` for the
full list. `docs/USER_GUIDE.md` is the end-user guide: first runs on
each model, then every `run` option one by one.
`./andesim run --mode hybrid --print-memmap --engine <id>` prints the
hybrid-supported guest memory map (USER_GUIDE section 5.5).

## Host dependencies

- C/C++ toolchain (clang preferred), CMake >= 3.20, ninja
- Python 3
- glib-2.0 dev (for the QEMU plugin)
- pkg-config
- a prebuilt `qemu-system-riscv64` (external; this repo no longer builds QEMU --
  set `QEMU_BIN_DIR` in `config.env`)
- a prebuilt vsim (external; this repo no longer builds vsim -- set `VSIM_BIN_DIR`
  in `config.env` to your vsim checkout's `build/` dir)

## Outputs

After `bash scripts/build_all.sh`:

- `qemu_plugin/libhybrid_handoff.so` (+ `libhotIterationLoop.so`, the `andesim profile` plugin)

QEMU and vsim are external prebuilt binaries: `$QEMU_BIN_DIR/qemu-system-riscv64`
and `$VSIM_BIN_DIR/sim_*` (set both in `config.env`).

# Out-of-tree build for the andesim QEMU TCG plugins. Standalone from the vsim
# CMake build because the plugins link against QEMU's plugin API + glib. Plugin
# sources live here and build here -- never inside the QEMU source tree.
#
# QEMU's plugin API header is vendored at include/qemu-plugin.h (a verbatim copy

# with NO QEMU source tree present -- only the built qemu-system-* binary is
# integrated externally. Re-copy the header if the target QEMU's plugin API bumps.
#

#   make            # build both
#   make clean

#   libhybrid_handoff.so    -- hybrid QEMU<->vsim handoff plugin (product)
#   libhotIterationLoop.so  -- hot inner-loop detector (`andesim profile`)

GLIB_CFLAGS := $(shell pkg-config --cflags glib-2.0)
GLIB_LIBS   := $(shell pkg-config --libs   glib-2.0)

HYBRID_INCLUDE ?= ../include

=== paths.sh ===
# Shared path resolution for the top-level e2e harness + drivers.
# Sourced (not executed). Provides:
#   TOP_ROOT                  - absolute path of the repo root
#   hybrid_resolve_paths()    - sets VSIM_BIN, VSIM_QEMU, VSIM_PLUGIN,
#                               VSIM_ELF from TOP_ROOT (unless already
#                               exported by caller) and exits 77 (CTest
#                               skip) if any artifact is missing. Reads
#                               FIXTURE for the VSIM_ELF default.
#   hybrid_describe_int F [BIN] - print integer field F from an engine's
#                               --describe JSON (BIN defaults to $VSIM_BIN);
#                               empty output if absent/unprobeable. The ONE
#                               shell parser of the descriptor wire format.
#   plugin_qemu_drain LOG ARGS [QEMU_ARGS...] - spawn QEMU for a plugin-only
#                               drain test (boots $VSIM_ELF with the plugin
#                               attached); sets RC to QEMU's exit code.

TESTS_LIB_DIR=$(cd -- "$(dirname -- "${BASH_SOURCE[0]}")" && pwd)
TOP_ROOT=$(cd -- "$TESTS_LIB_DIR/../.." && pwd)

if [ -z "${HYBRID_TOOLCHAIN:-}" ] && [ -f "$TOP_ROOT/config.env" ]; then
  . "$TOP_ROOT/config.env"
fi

hybrid_resolve_paths() {
  # VSIM_BIN_DIR / QEMU_BIN_DIR come from the environment or from the
  # config.env sourced above; there is no in-tree fallback (both simulators
  # are external prebuilts). Unset -> a nonexistent path -> skip below.
  VSIM_BIN="${VSIM_BIN:-${VSIM_BIN_DIR:-}/sim_ax45mpv_premium}"
  VSIM_QEMU="${VSIM_QEMU:-${QEMU_BIN_DIR:-}/qemu-system-riscv64}"
  VSIM_PLUGIN="${VSIM_PLUGIN:-$TOP_ROOT/qemu_plugin/libhybrid_handoff.so}"
  VSIM_ELF="${VSIM_ELF:-$TOP_ROOT/tests/fixtures/${FIXTURE}.elf}"
  for f in "$VSIM_BIN" "$VSIM_QEMU" "$VSIM_PLUGIN" "$VSIM_ELF"; do
    if [ ! -e "$f" ]; then
      echo "skip: $f not built; run 'source ./setup.sh' and 'make -C tests/fixtures'"
      exit 77
    fi
  done
}

# Extract one integer field from an engine's --describe JSON. $1 = field name,
# $2 = engine binary (default $VSIM_BIN). Prints nothing when the field is
# absent or the binary cannot be probed, so callers can `[ -n ... ]`-gate.
hybrid_describe_int() {
  "${2:-$VSIM_BIN}" --describe 2>/dev/null \
    | sed -n "s/.*\"$1\": *\([0-9][0-9]*\).*/\1/p" | head -n1
}

# Spawn QEMU for a plugin-only drain test: boot $VSIM_ELF on andes_ae350 with
# the hybrid plugin attached, stdin detached, combined output to LOG.
#   plugin_qemu_drain LOG PLUGIN_ARGS [EXTRA_QEMU_ARGS...]
# PLUGIN_ARGS is the plugin argument string after "$VSIM_PLUGIN," (e.g.
# "outfile=$STATE"). Sets RC to QEMU's exit code -- deliberately not local,
# callers gate on it -- and toggles errexit off around the spawn exactly like
# every call site used to. No shared-memory backend: plugin-only tests have
# no vsim leg, so nothing else ever opens the mmap, and the machine's default
# RAM is the same 128 MiB the backend used to force.
plugin_qemu_drain() {
  local log="$1" plugin_args="$2"; shift 2
  set +e
  "$VSIM_QEMU" \
    -machine andes_ae350 \
    -cpu andes-ax45mpv,vlen=512 \
    -nographic \
    -semihosting-config enable=on,target=native \
    -bios "$VSIM_ELF" \
    "$@" \
    -plugin "$VSIM_PLUGIN,$plugin_args" </dev/null >"$log" 2>&1
  RC=$?
  set -e
}

# Write a 32-bit little-endian word into a binary file (pattern staging for
# the LM/HVM backdoor-load tests). $1 = file, $2 = byte offset, $3 = value.
put_word_le() {
  local v=$3 bytes="" i
  for i in 0 8 16 24; do
    bytes+=$(printf '\\x%02x' $(( (v >> i) & 0xff )))
  done
  # shellcheck disable=SC2059
  printf "$bytes" | dd of="$1" bs=1 seek="$2" conv=notrunc status=none

# Hybrid Simulator - Functional Requirements Specification

Status: draft v0.1. Written 2026-05-29. Owner: Nick.
Audience: Engineering, QA, IP/Legal, Sales engineering.

Companion to `MRD.md` (commercial product view). This document is
the **engineering contract**: every shippable behavior of Andes
HybridSim v1.0, with one-line acceptance criteria per requirement.

Requirement IDs are stable across drafts. Each FR traces back to
one or more MR-x in MRD.md.

---

## 1. Scope and Definitions

### 1.1 In scope

Andes HybridSim v1.0, the commercial Tier-2 hybrid simulator
described in `MRD.md` sections 1-2. Specifically:

- `hsim` driver CLI
- QEMU (Andes fork) with hybrid plugin
- vsim cycle engine (Verilator-derived, encrypted)
- State transport library (`hybrid_state_v1`)
- Trigger toolkit (magic-CSR, PC-watch)
- Pipeline trace converter (kanata, Clarity DB)
- License daemon
- Installer, documentation, sample workloads

### 1.2 Out of scope (v1.0)

- Non-Andes RISC-V ISA variants
- QEMU + Alioth (cycle-side Alioth) - documented as future in MRD
- FPGA backend
...

### FR-301 - `hsim` CLI

Top-level entry. Subcommands:
- `hsim run` - one-shot workload execution
- `hsim trace` - trace-only mode (kanata, clarity)
- `hsim checkpoint` - QEMU1 checkpoint management
- `hsim license` - license daemon control / diagnostics
- `hsim diag` - capture bug report bundle
- `hsim version` - prints versions of all components

- Acceptance: `--help` for every subcommand; exit codes per Unix convention.
- Traces: MR-J, MR-K

### FR-302 - Configuration file format

`hsim.config.yaml` shall specify trigger config, workload paths,
cycle-engine params, license server, output format. Schema-validated.

- Acceptance: bad config produces actionable error pointing at the offending line.
- Traces: MR-J, MR-K

### FR-303 - JSON output report
=== FRS 315-335 (install/distro) ===
- Traces: MR-E, MR-H

### FR-403 - Host OS support

v1.0 ships for x86_64 Linux only. Supported distros: Ubuntu 22.04
LTS, RHEL 8 and 9, SUSE SLES 15. No Windows, no macOS.

- Acceptance: install + smoke test passes on each supported distro.
- Traces: MRD section 8

### FR-404 - Toolchain compatibility

ELFs produced by:
- Andes GNU toolchain (current and previous release)
- Andes LLVM toolchain (current release)
- Upstream RISC-V GCC (current release)

shall be accepted.

- Acceptance: a benchmark built with each toolchain round-trips.
- Traces: MR-A

Audit complete. Factual inventory below.

## 1. License / copyright / SPDX

**No license file anywhere in the tracked tree.** `git ls-files` (269 files) contains no `LICENSE`, `COPYING`, `NOTICE`, or `LICENSE.txt`. (The `LICENSE`/`COPYING` files found on disk are all under `/home/nick/work/andesim/build/qemu/pyvenv/` — untracked pip/meson vendored artifacts, not this project's.)

**Zero first-party copyright headers.** No source file in `driver/`, `runtime/`, `scripts/`, `tests/` carries a copyright or license header. The only hits:

| File | What it is |
|---|---|
| `/home/nick/work/andesim/qemu_plugin/include/qemu-plugin.h` | Third-party vendored QEMU header. `SPDX-License-Identifier: GPL-2.0-or-later` (line 8). The **only** SPDX tag in the repo. |
| `/home/nick/work/andesim/runtime/trap.S` | `Copyright (c) 2017 Andes Technology Corporation` (line 2) — no license text, no SPDX |
| `/home/nick/work/andesim/qemu_plugin/hotIterationLoop.c` | `Copyright (C) 2026` (line 14) — no owner named |
| `/home/nick/work/andesim/driver/vsim_filter.{cpp,hpp}`, `cmd_run.cpp`, `vsim_filter_test.cpp` | The word "Copyright" is only *string matching* on vsim's stdout banner, not a header |

Licensing consequence: `qemu_plugin/hybrid_handoff.c` and `hotIterationLoop.c` compile against a GPL-2.0-or-later header and load into QEMU as plugins — a GPL question with no answer recorded in-repo.

The `include/` submodule (`andesim_abi`) also has **no license file** (`grep -ril 'licen|copyright|SPDX' include/` → empty).

## 2. Version numbers

**There is no product version anywhere.**

- No `VERSION` file (tracked or untracked).
- No `--version` flag. Confirmed empirically: `/home/nick/work/andesim/build/andesim --version` → `andesim: unknown option: --version`. `git grep -- '--version'` returns nothing.
- `/home/nick/work/andesim/driver/CMakeLists.txt:11` — `project(andes_sim CXX)`. **No `VERSION` argument.** (Also note the project is named `andes_sim` while the binary target is `andesim`.)
- `cmake_minimum_required(VERSION 3.20)` is the only "VERSION" token in the build system.
- `git tag -l` → exactly one tag: **`andesim-repair-backup`** (points at `b969853`, "docs(skill): csr-transport-bringup"). It is a developer safety tag, not a release.
- The only versions in the codebase are internal wire-format ABI versions, not product versions: `HYBRID_STATE_VERSION` (`driver/state.hpp:54`) and `VLINUX_MANIFEST_VERSION` (`driver/manifest.cpp:31`, currently 3).

A `version` command is a *specified but unimplemented* requirement: `docs/FRS.md` FR-301 lists `hsim version - prints versions of all components`.

## 3. CHANGELOG / release notes / NEWS

**None.** No `CHANGELOG`, `NEWS`, `RELEASES`, or equivalent, tracked or on disk. The closest artifacts are roadmap docs (`ROADMAP.md`, `ROADMAP_LINUX_RUNTIME.md`, `REFACTOR_ROADMAP.md`, `ROADMAP_HTIF_WINDOW.md`) — engineering plans, not user-facing release notes. Release history is only recoverable from the 323 commit messages.

## 4. Install / packaging machinery

**No install path exists. Nothing can be installed off the build machine.**

- **No CMake `install()` rule.** `driver/CMakeLists.txt` has zero `install()` calls; it only sets `RUNTIME_OUTPUT_DIRECTORY`.
- **No `install` target in any Makefile.** All four Makefiles declare only `all`/`clean` (+ `dump`/`rv32`/`rtlib`):
  - `qemu_plugin/Makefile:31` → `.PHONY: all clean`
  - `runtime/Makefile:54` → `.PHONY: all clean`
  - `runtime/linux/Makefile:32` → `.PHONY: all clean rtlib`
  - `tests/fixtures/Makefile:93` → `.PHONY: all clean dump rv32`
- **No `.deb`, `.rpm`, conda recipe, `setup.py`, `pyproject.toml`, spec file, or tarball script.** `git ls-files` matching `release|package|dist|publish|deploy` returns exactly one file, and it is a test, not a packager: `/home/nick/work/andesim/tests/andes_sim/test_andes_sim_release_surface.sh` (a contract test asserting `--help` shows only `run/profile/list/doctor` and never leaks the string "verilator" or the removed `build/test/state-diff/cluster/archive/replay/estimate` commands).
- **Build orchestration only** (`/home/nick/work/andesim/scripts/build_all.sh`): targets `all|plugin|fixtures|runtime|vlinux`; header explicitly says "It only orchestrates the existing build scripts / Makefiles". Everything is consumed **in place** from the repo tree — users are told to link with `-B <repo>/build/runtime -specs=andesim.specs` (`runtime/Makefile:12`), i.e. the repo checkout *is* the install prefix.

**`/home/nick/work/andesim/Dockerfile.runtime`** — the only container/packaging artifact:
- `ARG BASE_IMAGE=andes-vsim-env:latest` — depends on an image built by a **separate external vsim repo's** root Dockerfile (target `env`); that image is not produced here.
- `COPY . /opt/hybrid_sim` — bakes the entire repo (including `.git` unless a `.dockerignore` exists — **there is no `.dockerignore`**).
- `RUN make -C qemu_plugin && ./scripts/build_driver.sh && make -C runtime` — note `make -C runtime` needs `HYBRID_TOOLCHAIN`, which is **not** set in the Dockerfile and comes from the gitignored `config.env`; `setup.sh` is deliberately not run ("setup.sh is NOT used here").
- `ENTRYPOINT ["/opt/hybrid_sim/andesim"]`.
- QEMU and vsim are **not** in the image; they must be bind-mounted at run time.
- Its own comment states the packaging gap: `"The publish registry/name is still an open question"`.
- Consumer: `/home/nick/work/andesim/scripts/run_in_container.sh`, used only for the macOS path (`./andesim` re-execs into it when `uname -s` = Darwin). Defaults `ANDESIM_IMAGE=andesim-runtime:latest` — a local-only tag, no registry.

## 5. CI configuration

**None.** No `.github/`, `.gitlab-ci.yml`, `Jenkinsfile`, `.gitea/`, `.circleci/`, `.drone.yml`, `.travis.yml`, `azure-pipelines.yml`, or Woodpecker config — verified both on disk and via `git ls-files`. Testing is manual via `/home/nick/work/andesim/scripts/test_all.sh` (phases `lint`, `unit`, `contract`, `e2e`). `Dockerfile.runtime`'s header says images are "Built ON LINUX (CI or a Linux workstation)" — that CI does not exist in this repo.

## 6. What a fresh user must supply

### `config.env.example` → copied to `config.env` on first `source ./setup.sh`

**The committed template ships one developer's absolute paths as the defaults** (`/home/nick/work/andesim/config.env.example`):

| Var | Committed default | Required? | Failure if missing |
|---|---|---|---|
| `HYBRID_TOOLCHAIN` | `/local/nick/SW_Release/build-ast540/build-toolchain/linux/nds64le-elf-newlib-v5d` | **Yes** | `setup.sh` hard-fails: `HYBRID_TOOLCHAIN not set` or `has no bin/ directory`; `runtime/Makefile`, `runtime/linux/Makefile`, `tests/fixtures/Makefile:12` all `$(error)` |
| `HYBRID_TOOLCHAIN32` | `/local/nick/.../nds32le-elf-newlib-v5d` | Optional | rv32 runtime/fixtures skipped |
| `LINUX_TOOLCHAIN` | `/local/nick/SW_Release/build-ast542/.../nds64le-linux-glibc-v5d` | Optional | `tests/fixtures/Makefile:108` `$(error)` only when a glibc fixture is built |
| `LLAMA_CPP_DIR` | `/home/nick/work/llama.cpp` | Optional | `tests/vlinux/test_vlinux_llama_smoke.sh` skips. Also needs a hand-built `build-rv64-static/bin/llama-completion` and `models/Bonsai-4B-Q1_0.gguf` |
| `QEMU_BIN_DIR` | `/home/nick/work/qemu_andesim/build/qemu` | **Yes** | `setup.sh` fails if unset or if **both** `qemu-system-riscv32` **and** `qemu-system-riscv64` are not executable there |
| `VSIM_BIN_DIR` | `/home/nick/work/vsim_andesim/build` | **Yes** | `setup.sh` fails if unset or no `sim_*` binaries found |

Neither QEMU nor vsim is built by this repo — both are **external prebuilt binaries from separate repos** (`qemu_andesim`, `vsim_andesim`/`hybrid_vsim`), which a fresh user must obtain and build first. `scripts/run_llama_hybrid.sh:13` additionally hardcodes `LLAMA_DIR="${LLAMA_DIR:-/home/nick/work/llama.cpp}"`.

### `setup.sh` (must be **sourced**, not executed)

Steps 0/3–3/3: load `config.env` → validate `HYBRID_TOOLCHAIN/bin` → validate both QEMU binaries → validate `sim_*` → `make -C qemu_plugin`. Then prepends both dirs to `PATH` and exports `QEMU_BIN_DIR`, `VSIM_BIN_DIR`, `VSIM_QEMU`, `VSIM_QEMU32`, `VSIM_PLUGIN`. If run instead of sourced it warns the PATH change is lost. Every failure is a hard `return 1` with a message naming `config.env`.

### `scripts/build_all.sh` (default target `all`)

`bash setup.sh` → `make -C tests/fixtures` → `make -C runtime/linux`. Requires everything `setup.sh` requires, plus the RISC-V toolchain for the fixture/runtime compiles. The driver is **not** built here (self-bootstraps).

### Host tools

From `README.md` "Host dependencies": C/C++ toolchain (clang preferred), **CMake >= 3.20**, ninja, **Python 3**, **glib-2.0 dev** (`qemu_plugin/Makefile` calls `pkg-config --cflags/--libs glib-2.0`), **pkg-config**.

From `driver/cmd_doctor.cpp` (`andesim doctor`, lines 170–232): `make` (**FAIL** if absent), `podman` (**WARN**), `HYBRID_TOOLCHAIN` set + `bin/riscv64-unknown-elf-gcc` present, `/dev/shm` present with **≥ 4 GB free** (WARN below), plus INFO rows for `nproc`/JOBS. Doctor also checks artifacts exist: `sim_ax45mpv_premium`, `VSIM_QEMU`, plugin `.so`, and fixture ELFs — failures say `"missing ... -- run scripts/build_all.sh"`.

Additional undeclared tools discovered in scripts: `python3` (4 tracked `.py` files; `tests/andes_csr/test_csr_coverage_complete.sh:15` → `python3 required`), `uv`/`uvx` (`scripts/notebook_server.sh`, JupyterLab), `objcopy` (manifest injection), `podman`/`docker` (macOS path).

No `requirements.txt`, no pinned dependency manifest of any kind.

## 7. The `andesim` file at repo root

`/home/nick/work/andesim/andesim` is a **773-byte bash script**, mode `755`, not a binary. Full logic:

1. `set -euo pipefail`; resolves `ROOT` from `BASH_SOURCE`.
2. If `${ANDESIM_OS:-$(uname -s)}` = `Darwin`, `exec bash "$ROOT/scripts/run_in_container.sh" "$@"` (macOS is run-only, via podman machine — the shared mmap must stay VM-local, never on a virtiofs mount).
3. Otherwise `BIN="$ROOT/build/andesim"`; **`[ -x "$BIN" ] || bash "$ROOT/scripts/build_driver.sh" >&2`** — the self-bootstrap; then `exec "$BIN" "$@"`.

`scripts/build_driver.sh` runs `cmake -S driver -B build/driver -DCMAKE_BUILD_TYPE=Release -DCMAKE_RUNTIME_OUTPUT_DIRECTORY=<root>/build` then `cmake --build ... -j$(nproc)`.

Dependencies: host C++20 compiler, CMake ≥ 3.20, `nproc`, and `include/hybrid/state_abi.h` from the **submodule** (`target_include_directories(andesim PRIVATE .../../include)`). Per `driver/CMakeLists.txt` header: "no Verilator, no SystemC, no QEMU, no fmt/spdlog". Packaging-relevant: the wrapper is hard-wired to the repo layout (`$ROOT/build/andesim`, `$ROOT/scripts/`), so it cannot be relocated to `/usr/bin` as-is, and it will silently attempt a compile on any host where the binary is absent. Note the current `build/andesim` is 1.0 MB and `.gitignore`d.

## 8. Repo size and binary artifacts

- **Tracked content is small and clean.** Largest tracked file: `driver/cmd_run.cpp` at **42,571 bytes**. **Nothing tracked exceeds 1 MB.** Largest blob in the *entire history*: `docs/competition_landscape.ipynb` at 121,858 bytes. No committed binaries, ELFs, `.so`s, or model files.
- `git count-objects -vH`: `size-pack: 7.01 MiB`, `in-pack: 6008`, `count: 131`, `size: 1.55 MiB`. The project's own history is ~9 MB.
- **But `.git` is 3.8 GB**, and it is entirely stale submodule storage from a previous vendored-submodule layout:
  - `/home/nick/work/andesim/.git/modules/hybrid_qemu` — **3.0 GB**
  - `/home/nick/work/andesim/.git/modules/hybrid_vsim` — **804 MB**
  - `/home/nick/work/andesim/.git/modules/include` — 516 KB (the only live one)
  - `/home/nick/work/andesim/.git/modules/tools` — 4 KB
  
  Neither `hybrid_qemu` nor `hybrid_vsim` appears in `.gitmodules` any more (they were removed when QEMU/vsim became external prebuilts — first commit `6b9be8a`, "workspace skeleton with hybrid_qemu/hybrid_vsim submodules"). A `git clone` will not carry them, but every existing developer checkout does. `Dockerfile.runtime`'s `COPY . /opt/hybrid_sim` with no `.dockerignore` would copy all 3.8 GB into the image.
- Working tree is 1.4 GB, of which `build/` is 1.4 GB (ignored).
- **Build outputs are correctly gitignored** — `git status --porcelain -uall` shows **zero** untracked non-ignored files. Ignore rules: `/home/nick/work/andesim/.gitignore` line 1 `build/`, plus `qemu_plugin/.gitignore:1` (`*.so`) and `tests/fixtures/.gitignore:1` (`*.elf`). `config.env` is also gitignored.
- One additional artifact policy note in `.gitignore`: `AndeStar_V5_SPA_UM164_V1.7.pdf` is explicitly ignored as a "Proprietary Andes spec".

## 9. Submodules

`/home/nick/work/andesim/.gitmodules` in full — a single submodule:

```
[submodule "include"]
	path = include
	url = https://gitea.andestech.com/nick/andesim_abi.git
	branch = main
```

**The URL is internal-only.** `gitea.andestech.com` is an Andes-internal Gitea host, and the path is under a personal namespace (`nick/`), not an org. `git submodule status` → `9ecc0cc... include (heads/main)`, clean. `git -C include remote -v` confirms both fetch and push point at the same internal URL.

The parent repo is likewise internal and personally namespaced: `origin https://nick@gitea.andestech.com/nick/hybrid_sim.git`. `README.md` instructs `git clone --recursive https://gitea.andestech.com/nick/hybrid_sim`. Anyone outside the Andes network — or outside `nick`'s Gitea account permissions — cannot clone the repo or resolve the submodule, so `--recursive` clone is a hard blocker for external distribution.

Submodule contents (`include/`, 80 KB): `hybrid/{handoff_site,insn_match,reg_names,state_abi,state_abi_check,v_drain_policy,write_mask}.h` + `tests/{abi_compile_check.c,abi_compile_check.cpp,check.sh}` + `README.md`. Per its README it is the shared wire contract consumed by three components (`andesim` plugin+driver, and `hybrid_vsim` at `external/andesim_abi/`).

---

## Cross-cutting facts worth flagging

- **Product-name inconsistency.** `git grep -c` over tracked files: `andesim` × 518, `hybrid_sim` × 8. But `README.md`'s title is `# hybrid_sim`, the git remote is `hybrid_sim.git`, the container path is `/opt/hybrid_sim`, the CMake project is `andes_sim`, and the commercial docs call it **"Andes HybridSim"** with a CLI named **`hsim`** (`docs/FRS.md` FR-301). Four names for one product; nothing named "AndeSim" with that capitalization exists in the repo.

Recoverable via `git checkout -- docs/` — but the deletion is unstaged and one `git add -A` from becoming permanent.
